en.description:
This retro-inspired arcade game brings fast, pick-up-and-play action to Apple Watch. Designed specifically for the small screen, it delivers smooth side-scrolling gameplay, crisp pixel art, and simple, responsive controls that feel right at home on watchOS.

Control your helicopter as the world scrolls past, dodge obstacles, and react quickly as the challenge ramps up. Layered parallax backgrounds add depth and movement, while animated sprites capture the look and feel of classic arcade machines.

Built for short sessions and instant fun, this game is perfect for quick breaks, high-score chasing, and reliving the golden age of arcades — now playable right on your wrist.

Features

Retro arcade gameplay optimized for Apple Watch

Pixel-perfect graphics and smooth animations

Parallax scrolling backgrounds for added depth

Simple, responsive controls ideal for the Digital Crown

Quick play sessions, classic challenge

Old-school arcade fun, reimagined for Apple Watch.
en.releaseNotes:
Added new level.
Added fighter jet
en.subtitle: Take to the skies!
